caseName: Trans World Airlines, Inc. v. Franklin Mint Corp.
caseNameFull: Trans World Airlines, Inc. v. Franklin Mint Corp. and Franklin Mint Corp. v. Trans World Airlines, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Motion of International Air Transport Association et al. for leave to intervene in No. 82-1186 denied. Alternative request to treat the brief as a brief amici curiae granted. Certiorari granted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 690 F. 2d 303.
